The risk analysis should quantify tolerances for alert fatigue and incorporate mitigation strategies (e.g., adaptive notification thresholds). While computer‑aided decision support is acceptable, autonomous prescribing of pharmacotherapy would shift liability toward the developer; therefore, the app must be clearly positioned as a supportive tool that requires clinician oversight.

The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) now publishes Digital Health Technology Assessment (DHTA) guidance that explicitly addresses digital therapeutics. The German Gemeinsamer Bundesausschuss (G‑BA) evaluates digital therapeutics through its “Leistungsbewertung” process.
